# `locomotion` content schema

<!-- Generated by pnpm content:docs from the "locomotion" schema in src/content/registry.ts; do not edit. -->

One JSON file per entry in `src/content/data/locomotion/`. Fields marked "required" must be present;
every other field takes the default shown when omitted ("—" = stays absent).

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | id | required | Profile id creatures refer to, e.g. "goblin". |
| `name` | string | required | Display name (editor and docs). |
| `notes` | string | required | Why these values (canon, real-world reference, intended users), for owner review. |
| `agent` | object | required | Nav-mesh agent size. |
| `agent.radius` | number > 0 | required | Nav agent radius, m (clearance from walls). |
| `agent.height` | number > 0 | required | Nav agent height, m (headroom it needs). |
| `modes` | object | required | Locomotion modes by name, at least one; absent = it cannot move that way. |
| `modes.walk` | object | — | Walking on the navmesh. |
| `modes.walk.speeds` | object | required | Speed per gait, m/s. |
| `modes.walk.speeds.sneak` | number > 0 | required | Sneak speed, m/s (investigate, stalk). |
| `modes.walk.speeds.walk` | number > 0 | required | Walk speed, m/s (patrol, idle); at least sneak. |
| `modes.walk.speeds.run` | number > 0 | required | Run speed, m/s (chase, combat, flee); at least walk. |
| `modes.walk.stepHeight` | number ≥ 0 | required | Tallest step it walks up without a jump, m; at most agent.height. |
| `modes.walk.maxSlope` | number 0–90 | required | Steepest walkable slope, degrees. |
| `modes.walk.jumpHeight` | number ≥ 0 | required | Highest ledge it can jump up onto, m (jump links); 0 = never jumps. |
| `modes.walk.maxDrop` | number ≥ 0 | required | Highest drop it takes deliberately, m (drop links). |
| `modes.walk.wadeDepth` | number ≥ 0 | required | Deepest water it wades through, m; 0 = keeps out of water. |
| `modes.climb` | object | — | Climbing surfaces marked `climbable` (climb links). |
| `modes.climb.speeds` | object | required | Speed per gait, m/s. |
| `modes.climb.speeds.sneak` | number > 0 | required | Sneak speed, m/s (investigate, stalk). |
| `modes.climb.speeds.walk` | number > 0 | required | Walk speed, m/s (patrol, idle); at least sneak. |
| `modes.climb.speeds.run` | number > 0 | required | Run speed, m/s (chase, combat, flee); at least walk. |
| `modes.climb.maxGrade` | integer 1–3 | required | Hardest `climbable` grade it climbs: 1 ladders and ivy, 2 rough walls, 3 sheer. |
| `modes.fly` | object | — | Kinematic flight at a height offset; also crosses gaps and water. |
| `modes.fly.speeds` | object | required | Speed per gait, m/s. |
| `modes.fly.speeds.sneak` | number > 0 | required | Sneak speed, m/s (investigate, stalk). |
| `modes.fly.speeds.walk` | number > 0 | required | Walk speed, m/s (patrol, idle); at least sneak. |
| `modes.fly.speeds.run` | number > 0 | required | Run speed, m/s (chase, combat, flee); at least walk. |
| `modes.fly.maxAltitude` | number > 0 | required | Highest it flies above the ground below, m (height-offset flight, e11.4). |
| `modes.swim` | object | — | Swimming in water too deep to wade. |
| `modes.swim.speeds` | object | required | Speed per gait, m/s. |
| `modes.swim.speeds.sneak` | number > 0 | required | Sneak speed, m/s (investigate, stalk). |
| `modes.swim.speeds.walk` | number > 0 | required | Walk speed, m/s (patrol, idle); at least sneak. |
| `modes.swim.speeds.run` | number > 0 | required | Run speed, m/s (chase, combat, flee); at least walk. |
| `modes.swim.dives` | boolean | required | Whether it swims underwater (false = surface only). |
| `modes.burrow` | object | — | Digging through diggable materials (burrow links). |
| `modes.burrow.speeds` | object | required | Speed per gait, m/s. |
| `modes.burrow.speeds.sneak` | number > 0 | required | Sneak speed, m/s (investigate, stalk). |
| `modes.burrow.speeds.walk` | number > 0 | required | Walk speed, m/s (patrol, idle); at least sneak. |
| `modes.burrow.speeds.run` | number > 0 | required | Run speed, m/s (chase, combat, flee); at least walk. |
| `modes.burrow.materials` | list of ref → material (at least 1) | required | Material presets it digs through (burrow links), e.g. "earth". |
| `modes.wallcrawl` | object | — | Crawling on any solid wall, whatever its climbing grade. |
| `modes.wallcrawl.speeds` | object | required | Speed per gait, m/s. |
| `modes.wallcrawl.speeds.sneak` | number > 0 | required | Sneak speed, m/s (investigate, stalk). |
| `modes.wallcrawl.speeds.walk` | number > 0 | required | Walk speed, m/s (patrol, idle); at least sneak. |
| `modes.wallcrawl.speeds.run` | number > 0 | required | Run speed, m/s (chase, combat, flee); at least walk. |
| `modes.wallcrawl.ceilings` | boolean | required | Whether it also crawls upside down across ceilings. |
| `modes.stationary` | object | — | Never moves; must be its only mode. |
| `squeezes` | boolean | `false` | Whether it fits through crawlspaces (nav area `crawlspace`). |
| `opensDoors` | boolean | `false` | Whether it opens unlocked doors (door links). |
| `areaCosts` | map of `"ground"` \| `"water-shallow"` \| `"water-deep"` \| `"crawlspace"` → number 0.1–100 | `{}` | Path-cost multiplier per nav area (ground, water-shallow, water-deep, crawlspace); unlisted areas cost 1. |
